decisions.reason: Product A has its own webpage and multiple models, signaling high public commitment and substantial sunk costs, so escalation makes dropping very unlikely.
Although only mentioned on the website, the digital twin service builds on established offerings and fits the firm's stated direction, so management is likely to persist.

With only a website mention, no product line, and a service close to existing offers, it has the least sunk commitment, but early results can still be seen as temporary, so a drop is less likely than not.
As a product line with several models, it represents significant investment despite limited public visibility, so escalation favors keeping it.
The launch was publicly quantified with a quote, indicating visible commitment, which increases the cost of dropping and supports persistence.
